opt.title: Optimizer
opt.intro: Bayesian budget advisor (Thompson sampling over conversions, 30 days of history). Everything here is only a recommendation — you apply it, campaign by campaign, and every change passes through the safeguards (±20% per step, caps).
opt.pacingOver: We are ahead of plan by {dev}% — at this pace the budget runs out before the end of the month.
opt.pacingUnder: We are behind by {dev}% — there is unused budget ({days} days left).
opt.pacingOk: The pace is on track (deviation {dev}%, threshold ±15%).
opt.pacingOff: Off — set GUARD_MONTHLY_BUDGET in the environment to track the monthly spend pace.
opt.skipNoBase: under 10 clicks or no spend — no basis
opt.needTwo: at least 2 campaigns with data are required
opt.poolLine: Total daily pool: {pool} · {draws} simulations · last {days} days. “Win probability” = how often the campaign is the most effective one in the simulations.
opt.forecastEmpty: At least a week of history on an active campaign is needed.
opt.forecastNote: EWMA (α=0.3) + day-of-week seasonality over the last 28 days. Platforms may legally spend up to 2× the daily budget on a given day.
dig.title: Weekly digest
dig.intro: The last 7 full days against the previous 7 — the same days of the week, so seasonality cancels itself out. The metrics are the unified five-part standard (spend · impressions · clicks · conversions · value) and apply across both platforms.
dig.noChanges: Nothing was touched — neither by a human nor by the rules.

camp.overdeliveryTail: — legal for the platforms, but watch the weekly total.

camp.noMetrics: No metrics yet — publish, activate and sync.

rules.title: Automation rules
rules.intro: A rule = metric + condition + action. It fires only on sufficient data (min. spend), has a cooldown, and budget changes are limited to ±20% per step and pass through the safeguards.
rules.name: Name
rules.mCtrDrop: CTR drop % vs. the previous window (fatigue)
rules.reco1: Pause on burned CPA: CPA > 2× the target, 7 days, min. spend 100 — do not act without 20+ conversions/statistical mass.
rules.reco2: Scaling a winner: ROAS > the target for 3+ consecutive days → +20% budget (more restarts the learning phase).
rules.reco3: Creative fatigue: frequency > 3.5 or CTR −20% vs. the 7-day average → rotate the creative.
rules.reco4: Daily stop threshold: spend today > 1.5× the daily budget → pause (platforms can exceed the daily budget by up to 2×).

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: Every action toward a platform — human or automatic — is recorded. This is the accountability evidence (GDPR Art. 5(2)) and the automation log. The records are in Bulgarian — the audit language is not translated.
